needs_review.question_text_raw: In this paper the author presents 16 different open problems in approximation theory which have tormented him and his co-authors during writing several books on approximation within the last years.

evidence.quote: In this paper the author presents 16 different open problems in approximation theory which have tormented him and his co-authors during writing several books on approximation within the last years. The problems are related to different areas of approximation theory as function spaces, polynomials, integral operators and non-linear approximation. Also, for some important results in approximation a simplification of proofs would by highly desirable.
